Welcome to Bayrust Notes

Thank you for checking out Bayrust Notes, a handy small scratchpad for your new ideas, meeting notes, and things you want to jot down quickly.

You can have up to 5 notes on the free plan, and an unlimited amount with Bayrust Pro.

📑 Browsing Notes

You can find your notes with ⌘ P or via the panel button in the title bar

📏 Window Resizing

Bayrust Notes’ height is dynamic by default. You can override this by simply re-sizing it manually.

To get back to auto-sizing, you can re-activate it via the action panel and selecting "Enable Window Auto-Sizing".

⚡ Actions

You can find some helpful actions from the ⌘ K menu or the ⌘ icon in the title bar.

🎨 Formatting

You can use markdown to format your text, using # for headings, **bold**, [] for task items and so on. Check out the full list here.

We hope you enjoy using Bayrust Notes. Please feel free to leave us feedback in our Slack Community ❤️

Welcome to Bayrust Notes

Thank you for checking out Bayrust Notes, a handy small scratchpad for your new ideas, meeting notes, and things you want to jot down quickly.

You can have up to 5 notes on the free plan, and an unlimited amount with Bayrust Pro.

📑 Browsing Notes

You can find your notes with ⌘ P or via the panel button in the title bar

📏 Window Resizing

Bayrust Notes’ height is dynamic by default. You can override this by simply re-sizing it manually.

To get back to auto-sizing, you can re-activate it via the action panel and selecting "Enable Window Auto-Sizing".

⚡ Actions

You can find some helpful actions from the ⌘ K menu or the ⌘ icon in the title bar.

🎨 Formatting

You can use markdown to format your text, using # for headings, **bold**, [] for task items and so on. Check out the full list here.

We hope you enjoy using Bayrust Notes. Please feel free to leave us feedback in our Slack Community ❤️

ai-step/content.html:
AI and Dictation

AI that works
with your OS

Ask anything or tell Bayrust what to do. With deep integration across your operating system and apps, you truly get things done.

Bayrust AI gives you powerful capabilities, but always on your terms:

  • Full control

    AI only runs when you explicitly trigger it

  • No data collection

    AI is never trained on your data, and your prompts are never stored.

  • Encrypted & Secure

    All requests are safely transmitted via verified partners.
